analysis.name: Provider-attributed Conduit chevron · pale variant
analysis.description: Chevron symbol returned by Brandfetch for conduit.ai. Current usage alongside the website wordmark has not been confirmed.

observed.composition: Single geometric mark centered in a square. The chevron is thick, uniformly filled, with rounded corners, pointing right. No photography, UI chrome, or secondary symbols.
observed.colors: Muted teal-green background; cream / off-white mark. No gradients or outlines visible.
observed.logo_placement: The chevron is the Conduit logo mark and fills most of the tile. Not a customer logo or compliance seal.

guidance.use_when: Reference inspection only until the brand owner confirms this variant.
guidance.how_to_use: Prefer the current website wordmark for draft concepts. Keep this provider original unchanged and pending approval.
guidance.avoid_when: Do not use as the approved primary logo, recolor it, or assume it replaces the website wordmark.
guidance.crop_and_placement: Do not crop the chevron or trim the square. Keep original aspect ratio and internal padding. Give the whole tile clear space rather than cutting into the mark.
guidance.background_suitability: Inspect the original on suitable contrast; brand owner must approve actual placement and variant usage.

analysis.inferred_audience: Brand and product designers applying the Conduit symbol
uncertainties: Official color names and whether a wordmark lockup exists are not visible.
Light-theme origin metadata is untrusted; the tile itself is teal with a light mark.
Provider domain attribution is verified; currency and approved use of this chevron variant are unresolved.
